name: eval_v1
description: Held-out test set for matcher v2. Written and frozen before any matcher-v2 code, never used for tuning. Synthetic: all people, companies and projects are invented. Labels drafted by an AI assistant and must be reviewed by a human before numbers are published as final.

requirements.text: Strong fundamentals in Python and TypeScript
Build CRUD applications using frameworks such as React or Vue
Deploy services to a major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure)
Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation and evals for LLM applications
Write SQL against relational databases such as PostgreSQL
Explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
Own the CI/CD pipeline for the team's services
Experience with Python and pandas for data analysis
Build churn or propensity models with scikit-learn or XGBoost
Write SQL to query a data warehouse such as BigQuery or Snowflake
Build dashboards in Tableau or Power BI
Lead analytics projects from scoping to delivery

evidence.text: Built a FastAPI backend and a React front end for an internal claims-review tool used by 40 adjusters.
Wrote the TypeScript client and Python services, with typed API contracts shared between them.
Deployed both services to Google Cloud Run with Terraform.
Wrote PostgreSQL queries and migrations for the claims schema.
Walked the operations managers through the cost and latency trade-offs of each hosting option in plain language.
Contributed to the team's GitHub Actions workflows by adding a lint step.
Prototyped a retrieval-augmented question-answering feature and measured answer accuracy on 120 labelled questions.
Read the Kubernetes documentation while the platform team migrated our services.
Completed a bootcamp module on React and built a to-do list app as homework.
Used Python and pandas to clean survey exports for a nonprofit.
Assisted a senior engineer in migrating a Flask service to FastAPI.
Joined code reviews for the team's Azure deployment scripts.
Queried a MySQL database to answer ad-hoc questions from the sales team.
Presented the platform team's CI/CD roadmap at an all-hands meeting.
Wrote unit tests in Jest for a TypeScript utility library.
Answered customer questions about billing over email.
Analyzed customer purchase data in Python with pandas to segment 2 million loyalty members.
Designed and analyzed a pricing A/B test across 60 stores, and reported the lift with confidence intervals.
Built an XGBoost churn model that flags at-risk subscribers each week.
Presented quarterly findings to the marketing and finance leads with no technical jargon.
Wrote Snowflake SQL to build the customer feature tables.
Led the loyalty analytics project from the first scoping workshop to the final rollout.
Scheduled the weekly feature refresh as an Airflow DAG.
Took a short course on causal inference and difference-in-differences.
Built Excel pivot tables to summarize weekly sales for store managers.
Helped the data science team clean training data in pandas.
Reviewed the results of an A/B test run by the growth team.
Read about propensity modeling and XGBoost in a textbook.
Used SQL to pull monthly revenue numbers from the reporting database.
Sent weekly status emails to the regional director.
Participated in planning meetings for the customer analytics roadmap.
Attended a webinar on dbt.
